description: Fetch verified Trustpilot customer reviews for any company domain (e.g. "printful.com" or "shopify.com"), complete with 1–5 star distribution histogram, aspect sentiment polarities, reviewer country/verification level, and company replies. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned (0 Credits if empty).

domain.description: Company website domain or Trustpilot URL, e.g. "printful.com", "wise.com", or "https://www.trustpilot.com/review/printful.com".

limit.description: Maximum reviews to return (1–20 per page).

page.description: Page number (1-indexed, up to 20 reviews per page).

name: trustpilot_reviews
title: Extract Trustpilot Verified Reviews & Sentiment Polarity
